current_code_fact: Both insertion policies use a saved-distance update. Slide-style insertion checks the two gaps beside the closest stop, and time-window insertion evaluates every gap and replays delivery times. The slide-style update reproduced all 20 days of logs and metrics byte for byte. Protection produced the same logs as time-window insertion on all 20 days.
